title: Looks Singular, Takes Plural Verb
notes:
👥 Groups of People

  • Police are
  • People are
  • Clergy are
  • Gentry are
  • Folk are

💼 Work Groups (when focusing on members)

  • Staff are
  • Crew are

💡 Quick Example Sentences

  • The police are on their way.
  • The cattle are in the field.
summary: Group nouns with no -s that still use 'are/were'.
